Those coordinates resolve to the small town of Lebec along I-5 in the Tejon Pass, where satellite imagery shows only small roadside commercial buildings (gas stations, shops) and rural residential — no distribution center of any kind.
fieldNotes.investigation: The only large-scale industrial development in the Lebec/Tejon area is the Tejon Ranch Commerce Center (TRCC), a major logistics park ~6 km north along I-5 near Wheeler Ridge (around 34.97-34.99, -118.95). TRCC contains roughly 8-12 large distribution buildings (anchored by a 1.7M sq ft IKEA DC, plus L'Oreal, Dollar General, Caterpillar, Famous Footwear, Camping World, RectorSeal and others). Multiple web searches (UNFI corporate locations, TRCC tenant announcements, real-estate trade press, job listings) did NOT surface UNFI as a named TRCC tenant, and no specific UNFI street address in the 93243 ZIP could be confirmed. Without distinguishing UNFI signage or a confirmed address, no single TRCC building could be positively identified as the UNFI facility.
fieldNotes.assessment: UNFI's published locations list does include 'Lebec' as a West-region point, but this may be a small West-region branch/cross-dock rather than a mega-DC, or the roster entry may be imprecise. All 22 classification fields are left at conservative defaults and flagged uncertain. Geofences and yardMetrics are null/zero. Recommend human verification of the exact UNFI Lebec address (likely within TRCC) before this site is used for outreach.
